_why: John, 12 Oct 2026: tN outline names use translators' words (Oracles, Announcement, Narrative). Each is shown through this table, which John approves once; a name not in the table shows as tN wrote it. Setting lines say when and to whom, one per book section, drawn from the tN book introduction. Nothing here shows until status is 'approved' (rule 2). Approved by John on 12 Oct 2026 with five edits.
